bestBets.overview: Unique race with all maidens out of the Tanya Parry stable. LILII BOREA showed good speed first-up and just found one better here last start. Strips fitter and back in distance she will take catching. PERRIERES has been finishing just out of placings in better maidens of late. Should go forward and make own luck. INSTIGATE has been a model of consistency this time in but just cannot break maiden. Will not get better chance than this while FLYING GISELLE joins new stable from NSW. Drawn ideally and she is a must for exotics.

raceTips.comment: LILII BOREA just found one better when resuming for the new stable over 1200m here but she did hold a three length margin back to the rest. With the added fitness, I think she’s the one to beat. PERRIERES kicks off for the new yard. She’s just the had the three starts and wasn’t far away when resuming last time in. INSTIGATE has been placed at her past four starts. She’s hard fit and can figure once again. PENINHAND struggled with the kickback at her first go here. With than run under her belt, she can improve.

Bumped by FLYING GISELLE leaving the 950 metres then raced ungenerously for a distance thereafter. Resented the kickback in the middle stages, losing ground.
Slow into stride. Resented the kickback in the middle stages.
Began awkwardly. Commenced to lay in leaving the 900 metres, bumping with FLYING GISELLE which as a result raced ungenerously for a distance.
Raced wide throughout.

bestBets.overview: BITTERBLUE finished too well getting the prize third-up from spell. Model of consistency and he can make it two in a row. POLLY HOFFA was placed here two starts back then bit disappointing when in the market behind Bitterblue last start. Prepared to forgive one poor effort and must include her in chances. MAKANUI was placed behind Bitterblue last start. Drawn to get the perfect run in behind the speed and he is a must for exotics while CLIODHNA MAEVE has not been all that far off them in recent starts and she is a must for first four players.

raceTips.comment: BITTERBLUE comes off a deserved win over 1100m at Julia Creek. A consistent galloper, he’s always thereabouts and he does perform particularly well here. He gets in nicely with the claim and the rise in trip will suit. CLIODHNA MAEVE wasn’t suited with the drop back to 800m last start. On the quick back up, the step out in distance suits and she’ll be strong late. HOWSE comes back in class and will appreciate the drop back in trip. The blinkers go back on and I expect to see a much improved performance from him. MAKANUI hasn’t been far away in recent runs. He does race well here but just needs to run out a strong 1450m.

bestBets.overview: ZEPHIRINE made it two in a row with an easy win at Julia Creek last start. Drawn to drive through and lead these and no reason she cannot win again. BONDI PROPHET was beaten less than a length in the small field at Julia Creek last start. If he produces similar he can sneak into a place again. MELATEN won with authority here two starts back then was too bad to be true here last start. He can bounce back while OUTCAST SOLDIER held ground when placed here last start. Will make own luck in first couple and must consider.

raceTips.comment: ZEPHIRINE is racing in red hot form, having won at four of her past five outings. She was a dominant winner over this track and trip two runs back and will take beating once again. STOKOMO hasn’t been far away in two runs for the new stable. At peak fitness, the rise in trip suits and he should find this easier than what he’s previously contested. BONDI PROPHET has been solid in both runs for the new stable and looks suited with the rise in trip. TELL US TOLL has closed off strongly at her past two and may appreciate the step up in journey.

bestBets.overview: GREAT COSMIC is working through his classes in dominant fashion. Won by over 9 lengths at Julia Creek last start and if he produces similar will be winning again. HEAVENLY LEGEND jumped to the front and proved too speedy at Blackall last start. He will sit up on the speed and will be tough to catch. GROOVE JET made it two in a row with a clear win last start. She is yet to miss a place on home track and will be in mix again while AMORE VELOCE resumes from spell in new stable. She raced in town last campaign and she will find this easier.

raceTips.comment: AMORE VELOCE resumes for the new stable and she does perform very well fresh. It’s been a while between drinks for the mare but she been racing against quality opposition and is sure to find this easier. HEAVENLY LEGEND is ultra consistent and proved too good last start over 1200m at Blackall. He loves it here at Mt Isa and the drop back in trip won’t worry him. GREAT COSMIC returns off a six week let up looking to make it four straight wins. He’s proven over this track and trip and will be strong late. VIKING VALOUR is racing well and loves it here at his home track. He does rise in grade but drops 4kgs after the claim and draws to get the right run.

formRaceEntries.commentStewards: Had to be steadied rounding the home turn as a result of VIKING VALOUR hanging out. Returned to the enclosure with blood in its mouth as a consequence of a minor abrasion to an upper tooth.

Began awkwardly. Hung out rounding the home turn placing HEAVENLY LEGEND in restricted room which as a consequence had to be steadied. Continued to hang out shortly upon straightening bumping with GREAT COSMIC.

bestBets.overview: SHE SMASHES raced on the speed and proved too smart winning here last start. Drawn to lead or get the perfect sit in behind the speed and she can make it two on the trot. MEDIA EMPIRE battled on well when placed at Julia Creek last start beaten less than 2 lengths. Drawn awkwardly but must consider. LAST DITCH EFFORT has finished just out of placings at last couple. This no harder and he can sneak a place while LONE ARTIST was strong winning last start and from ideal draw he will be in mix again.

raceTips.comment: NAPOLEON STRIKE is racing well but didn’t have a lot go his way last start at Julia Creek. He boasts an excellent record at the track and gets in nicely with the claim. SHE SMASHES dug deep to score over the 1000m here last start. Hard fit, the rise in distance suits and the inside draw is a big plus. OCTOBER REVOLUTION will appreciate the drop back to 1200m. He’s won two from three over this track and trip and can bounce back. LONE ARTIST is a last start winner and looks best of the rest.

bestBets.overview: REGAL JUDGEMENT finished too well winning at Barcaldine two starts back then he held his ground late last start when just out of placings. Should get right run behind speed and will have chance. POLLY HOFFA was bit disappointing last start but she had been placed in three runs prior and prepared to forgive one poor run. THREEFOLD comes into this having won last two starts. May find this a bit harder but drawn to get perfect run while MANIC LIGHT is never far away in his races and he is a must for first four players.

raceTips.comment: REGAL JUDGEMENT resumes. He won well first up last campaign and holds a solid record here at Mt Isa. The 1200m kick off looks ideal and the 2kg claim sees him in nicely. MANIC LIGHT won well over this track and trip three runs back. He needed the hit-out last start off a seven week freshen up and with the added the fitness, he can improve. FLY FIFER kicked off her preparation with back to back placings at Townsville but just struggled there last time in stronger company. She draws well and should find this easier. THREEFOLD is looking for three straight wins. A mare in form, she must be included.

bestBets.overview: RED CODE joins the Tanya Parry stable. He started favourite in better race at Gold Coast last start but he was poor. He is better than that and can bounce back. FORTUNAS GIRL won with something in hand at Julia Creek last start. She has a nice barrier and with right run should be right in the mix. HOLY HOLY HOLY chased home well enough to be just out of placings here last start. She gets her chance to sneak a place in this while MAGIC ANDERSON won maiden here two starts back then not disgraced last start. He is a must for first four players.

raceTips.comment: RED CODE is a recent addition to the Tanya Parry yard. With four weeks since his latest run, the drop back to 1200m looks ideal and if he can find the front, he’ll be in it for a long way. MAGIC ANDERSON was a dominant winner over this track and trip when two runs back but had no luck last start at Julia Creek. Archie McColm will take 2kgs off. CRYPTOLOGY is another stepping out for the Parry stable for the first time. Placed at his past four starts, he’s hard fit and racing well but he will need luck from the wide gate. HOLY HOLY HOLY resumes. Lightly raced, she showed talent in her first campaign but she does have the wide gate to overcome.
